meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
India mein online kurta sets ke liye ye brands achhe options hain:

- **Libas** – Office wear aur daily wear ke liye reliable; cotton, straight-fit aur palazzo sets. Aam taur par ₹999–₹1,500 ke aas-paas options milte hain.[1]
- **Biba** – Thoda premium look, festive aur semi-formal occasions ke liye. Iske sets Flipkart par bhi listed hain.[2]
- **W for Woman** – Elegant office wear aur better-finish fabrics ke liye.[2]
- **Aurelia** – Comfortable everyday aur workwear styles ke liye.[2]
- **GoSriKi** – Budget-friendly 3-piece kurta-pant-dupatta sets; rayon/viscose mein kaafi variety.[1][5]
- **Indo Era** – Trendy prints, Anarkali aur festive sets; generally affordable range.[5]
- **Ahalyaa** – Stylish prints aur occasion wear ke liye, especially Myntra/Nykaa Fashion par.
- **Gerua by Libas** – Libas ka more affordable, fashionable option; kuch sets ₹800 ke aas-paas bhi milte hain.[9]
- **Meesho sellers** – ₹200–₹600 budget mein bahut variety, lekin seller reviews, fabric details aur return policy zaroor check karein.[4]
- **Anouk** – Contemporary ethnic designs aur office/casual wear ke liye.[6]

**Meri quick recommendation:**

- **Best overall:** Libas  
- **Office wear:** Aurelia ya W for Woman  
- **Festive wear:** Biba ya Ahalyaa  
- **Budget mein 3-piece set:** GoSriKi ya Indo Era  
- **Under ₹600:** Meesho, par reviews dhyan se padhein  

Buy karne se pehle size chart, fabric—cotton rayon se zyada breathable hota hai—customer photos, dupatta included hai ya nahi, aur return policy check karein.
